summary: Certified end-to-end the two new features built this session: (B) Manual live-trip share on the ride SEARCHING screen and (A) Tourist Itineraries (Circuits) — save, list, public share link, public read-only page. 8/8 backend pytest cases PASS and 14/14 frontend UI assertions PASS. Both features are production-ready.

Public payload excludes _id.

per_check_results.console_errors: Only 1 cosmetic 401 at session start before auth cookie applied (pre-existing, documented in iteration_411). No errors in either circuits or share-tracking flows.

issues: Pre-existing (NOT introduced by either new feature): the 'Vérifiez votre email' toast at the bottom-right may visually sit close to the new [share-tracking-btn] CTA inside the bottom sheet — only a stylistic note; both elements remain interactive in the test run.

critical_code_review_comments: itineraries.py route is clean: explicit Pydantic-free validation via _clean_place + MAX_PLACES guard, secrets.token_urlsafe(9) for share_token (well-sized & unpredictable), _id excluded from both list and public projections, public endpoint only joins user.name (no PII leak). Good.

Public route order: GET /itineraries/{itin_id} and GET /itineraries/public/{token} — FastAPI matches them by path: /public/{token} has a static prefix so it wins. Confirmed no shadowing (test_public_invalid_token_returns_404 + test_existing_seed_public_token both 200/404 as expected).

Soft suggestion (non-blocking): consider rate-limiting POST /itineraries (no per-user quota beyond MAX_PLACES per circuit). Same for the public GET (an attacker could brute-force share_tokens — but secrets.token_urlsafe(9) gives ~70 bits of entropy which is adequate).

Frontend MyItinerariesPage + SharedItineraryPage testid coverage is exhaustive — every interactive element has a data-testid including per-step shared-step-{i}/shared-step-dir-{i} and per-card circuit-{action}-{id}. Excellent for automated testing.
Pre-existing (not new): /api/auth/me returns 401 at app boot before the auth cookie is sent — cosmetic, already noted in prior iterations.
seed_data_creation: Backend test created and deleted 1 TEST_Circuit_API_QA circuit. UI test created ride ride_fe9b728ea58b (left in searching state). No persistent test data left behind besides the existing famtester seed circuit 'Découverte Fort-de-France'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both new features (B: live-trip share button & A: Circuits with public sharing) are CERTIFIED. Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_itineraries.py — reuse for regression. The /circuit/:token route works LOGGED OUT as required (no auth headers sent, payload includes title/places/owner_name and excludes _id). The share-tracking-btn appears on /ride/{id} as long as the ride is in 'searching' state (which is the default in preview because dispatch is disabled). To reach the searching screen quickly: /login/email -> /course -> fill 'Où allez-vous ?' with 'Schoelcher Martinique' -> wait 3s -> click .pac-item -> wait 4s -> click ride-choose-request-btn -> dismiss cancel-policy-ok if shown -> share-tracking-btn is in the bottom-sheet under 'Relancer la recherche'. The save-circuit-from-favorites E2E was NOT exercised because famtester has no favorites; backend API path was used as the request explicitly allowed (this is the documented fallback).
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Initial assumption that [my-circuits-link] should be in the global header was incorrect — re-reading the request and grep confirmed the testid lives on NearbyBusinessPage.js (Tourisme page) where it's actually wired. Verified on /nearby.
